## kwdb-install-deploy 1.2.1

- Documentation file `skill-card.md` has been removed from the project.
- No changes to functionality or installation workflow.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No user-facing behavior or functional changes in this release.

kwdb-install-deploy v1.1.0

- Added comprehensive step-by-step deployment guidance for KaiwuDB, including single-node and cluster modes.
- Enforced strict confirmation of all installation parameters; defaults must be explicitly shown and confirmed.
- Added mandatory log file inspection and clear reporting for installation failures, with no automated retries allowed.
- Outlined full configuration (deploy.cfg) process, including all required questions and user confirmations.
- Detailed prerequisites, user permissions, and hardware/OS requirements for installation.
- Clarified deployment and configuration workflows for both bare-metal and container environments.

kwdb-install-deploy 1.0.0

- Initial release of KWDB Install skill for guided script-based KaiwuDB deployment.
- Step-by-step workflow ensures all installation/configuration parameters are explicitly confirmed with the user.
- Strict handling rules: prohibits parameter guessing, reads and reports errors from logs on failure, and never retries without user request.
- Supports both single-node and cluster (single/multi-replica) deployments in Linux environments.
- Verifies prerequisites and installation package before proceeding.
- Automates generation and confirmation of configuration, followed by safe command execution and status check.
